USA 2026: en homogen post börsnoterade a: US 2026: one homogeneous lot of listed shares with the same historical acquisition date. Withdrawals sell a proportional share of this lot. No additional purchases, reinvestment or sales with repurchase; new lots require separate accounts and a wash-sale check. Dividends are paid to household cash. Short- or long-term gains use actual holding time; qualified dividends require verified company and holding conditions. Historical realized gains and losses must be split into four short-/long-term gain/loss entries in opening state.
